title: Your Nervous System IS Classroom Management #classroommanagement #classroomenvironment
description:
Your nervous system is one of your most important classroom management tools.

Students are constantly scanning the room when they’re dysregulated, overwhelmed, anxious, or escalated. They are looking to the adults around them for cues about whether they are safe.

That doesn’t mean teachers should be perfectly calm all the time. We’re human too.

But when we learn how to regulate ourselves, slow down our responses, and stay grounded during difficult moments, it can completely change the emotional climate of a classroom.

A regulated adult can help de-escalate a dysregulated child.

This is why trauma-informed behavior support is so much deeper than rewards, consequences, or behavior charts.

It starts with nervous system safety and co-regulation.
